name: Universidade de Coimbra
summary: Public university in Coimbra with eight faculties and a nursing school; its 50 bachelor's are taught in Portuguese, via the national contest.

ib.text: With Portuguese, apply through the national contest: IB grade 50%, IB exams replacing entrance exams 50%; IB Portuguese A at HL can replace the Portuguese exam (2026 table).

notes: UC's international-student calls are for non-EU applicants; EU/EEA citizens apply through the national contest.
